name: Fay B.

parsed.public_post: Good news, villagers! We have received a fresh, safe flour batch and our bread is back on the shelves today. All loaves are safe to eat. To thank you for your patience, the first loaf is on the house – enjoy!
parsed.coop_message: Fresh flour arrived overnight; start baking immediately. Process any pending refunds today and note that today's sales will include a complimentary first loaf per resident to rebuild trust. Keep track of inventory and update the clinic on safety status.
parsed.reason: Resume safe sales and restore villagers' confidence while offering a goodwill incentive.
